verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's core product is a physical mail-handling service: a real U.S. street address, staff who open, scan, forward and shred mail, check deposits, and registered-agent service. Self-hosting that is a category error; buyers comparing virtual mailbox providers would not reasonably ask whether they can run it on their own infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable software component that would make the axis apply.
